refresh_notes: Every row carries its own source_url, as_of date and confidence. See REFRESH.md for how to re-verify. confidence values: verified = read from the vendor's own pricing page; unverified = best available third-party reporting, vendor page not reachable at capture time; disputed = sources materially disagree, do not quote to a client without checking.

offerings.name: Claude Fable 5.1
offerings.notes: Most capable widely released Anthropic model. Cache reads are 0.025x base input. Requires 30-day data retention; not available under zero data retention without authorization. No Priority Tier.

offerings.name: Claude Mythos 5.1
offerings.notes: Limited availability - only to organizations verified through Anthropic verification programs. Same capability and price as Fable 5.1.

offerings.name: Claude Fable 5
offerings.notes: Superseded by Fable 5.1 at the same per-token price but 4x more expensive cache reads ($1 vs $0.25). Prefer 5.1.

offerings.name: Claude Mythos 5
offerings.notes: Limited availability. Superseded by Mythos 5.1.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 5.5
offerings.notes: Current Opus and the general-purpose default. Cheaper than Opus 5 ($4/$20 vs $5/$25) with the same context and feature set. Cache reads are 0.05x base input. Fast mode available at $8/$40.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 5
offerings.notes: Superseded by Opus 5.5, which is cheaper on every axis. Fast mode available at $10/$50.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 4.8
offerings.notes: Supports Priority Tier, unlike Opus 5 and 5.5.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 4.7
offerings.notes: First model on the newer tokenizer, which produces roughly 30% more tokens for the same text than 4.6 and earlier. Same headline rate, higher effective cost per word.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 4.6
offerings.notes: Uses the older tokenizer - fewer tokens for the same text than 4.7 and later.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 4.5
offerings.notes: Context window not restated on the pricing page; 200K shown here is from the model docs and is lower confidence than the price.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 4.1
offerings.notes: Retired on the first-party API; still available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed). 3x the price of current Opus for less capability - do not start new work here.

offerings.name: Claude Opus 4
offerings.notes: Retired except on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed).

offerings.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
offerings.notes: Current Sonnet. Best price/capability balance in the Anthropic line for high-volume work - half the input cost of Opus 5.5 at 1M context. Cache reads are 0.05x base input.

offerings.name: Claude Sonnet 5
offerings.notes: The $2/$10 rate was announced as introductory pricing through 2026-08-31 but is now the standard price; the planned increase to $3/$15 was cancelled. Sonnet 5.5 has cheaper cache reads at the same token price.

offerings.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
offerings.notes: More expensive than Sonnet 5/5.5 ($3/$15 vs $2/$10) for less capability. Uses the older, more token-efficient tokenizer.

offerings.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
offerings.notes: Deprecated.

offerings.name: Claude Sonnet 4
offerings.notes: Retired except on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed).

offerings.name: Claude Haiku 5.5 (prompts up to 100K)
offerings.notes: Cheapest current Claude model by a wide margin - 20x cheaper input than Sonnet 5.5. This rate applies only to prompts up to 100,000 tokens; above that the price is 5x higher (separate row). This is the model the Brand Visibility Tracker uses for extraction.

offerings.name: Claude Haiku 5.5 (prompts over 100K)
offerings.notes: Same model ID as the row above - the price tier switches automatically once a prompt exceeds 100,000 tokens. Watch this if you ever feed long scraped pages into extraction.

offerings.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
offerings.notes: 10x the input price of Haiku 5.5 at a fifth of the context. No reason to pick this over Haiku 5.5 for new work.

offerings.name: Claude Haiku 3.5
offerings.notes: Retired except on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed).

offerings.name: Web search tool
offerings.notes: Charged on top of token costs. Retrieved page content is billed as input tokens, in the same turn and in every later turn of the conversation - this is what makes grounded runs far more expensive than the per-search fee suggests. Each search counts once regardless of result count. Failed searches are not billed.

offerings.name: Web fetch tool
offerings.notes: No per-call fee - you pay only token costs for fetched content. Rough guide: average webpage (10 kB) about 2,500 tokens; large doc page (100 kB) about 25,000 tokens; research PDF (500 kB) about 125,000 tokens. Use max_content_tokens to cap exposure.

offerings.name: Code execution tool
offerings.free_tier: 1,550 free hours per month per organization
offerings.notes: Free when used alongside web search or web fetch. Billed by execution time with a 5-minute minimum. If files are attached, time is billed even when the tool is not called, because files are preloaded onto the container.

offerings.name: Batch API discount
offerings.notes: 50% off both input and output tokens for asynchronous processing. The single biggest lever on cost for anything not latency-sensitive - a nightly batch of visibility prompts would cost half of what interactive runs cost. Not compatible with fast mode or Priority Tier.

offerings.name: US inference geography premium
offerings.notes: Setting inference_geo to 'us' on Claude 4.6 and later applies a 1.1x multiplier. Global (the default) is standard price. Only matters if a client contract requires US-only data routing.

offerings.name: Regional / multi-region endpoint premium (Bedrock, Google Cloud)
offerings.notes: Applies to Claude Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.5 and later on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Models on Google Cloud. Global endpoints are standard price.

offerings.name: Grounding with Google Search (Gemini 3 and newer)
offerings.free_tier: 5,000 free search requests per month, shared across Gemini 3 and newer models
offerings.notes: Billed on top of normal token charges. Reported consistently across sources and attributed to Google's own pricing page, but that page was not reachable at capture time - confirm before quoting.

offerings.name: Grounding with Google Search (Gemini 2.5)
offerings.notes: Older grounding rate for the 2.5 generation, reported by third parties only and not confirmed against Google's page. If accurate, 2.5-era grounding costs 2.5x the Gemini 3 rate - a reason to move any grounded Gemini calls onto a current model.

offerings.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (up to 200K context)
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only. Above 200K context the rate rises to $4 input / $18 output (separate row).

offerings.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (over 200K context)
offerings.notes: Long-context tier. Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only. Cheapest Gemini tier reported, but on the older 2.5 generation with the more expensive grounding rate.

offerings.name: Web search tool
offerings.notes: The one OpenAI figure sources agree on. Retrieved search content is billed as input tokens at your model's rate on top of the per-call fee. An older preview variant for non-reasoning models was reported at $25 per 1,000 calls with search tokens free.

offerings.name: GPT-6 Astra
offerings.notes: OpenAI's current model lineup could not be established from reachable sources - aggregators disagree on both names and prices, and some list models others do not mention at all. Reported as the flagship at $10/$50, with long-context requests over 272K tokens reported to raise the whole request to $20/$75. Treat every OpenAI row here as a placeholder until re-verified against OpenAI's own pricing page.

offerings.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
offerings.notes: Single source, reported released 2026-09-29. Not corroborated.

offerings.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
offerings.notes: Sources give either $4/$20 or $5/$30 for this model. Do not quote.

offerings.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: GPT-5.2
offerings.notes: Most sources agree on $1.75/$14 with cached inputs at a 90% discount and batch at roughly half. Context window reported as either 400K or 128K. GPT-5.2 Pro reported at $21/$168 and described as deprecated by one source.

offerings.name: Grok 4.7 (under 200K prompt tokens)
offerings.notes: Reported flagship. One source states it checked xAI's developer pricing page on 2026-10-25, which makes this the best-supported non-Anthropic model row in the catalog - but still not read first-hand. Cheapest output price per token of any flagship model listed here.

offerings.name: Grok 4.7 (200K prompt tokens and above)
offerings.notes: Long-prompt tier - doubles at the 200K threshold.

offerings.name: Grok 4.3
offerings.notes: Same reported price as the Grok 4.20 dated SKUs.

offerings.name: Grok Build 0.1
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: Live Search
offerings.notes: Billed per source, not per request - so a query across web, X, news and RSS costs 4 sources ($0.10) rather than one. Figure comes from a single older page and was not confirmed. If correct, this is the most expensive grounding surcharge in the catalog.

offerings.name: Sonar
offerings.notes: Most 2026 sources say $1/$1, but one aggregator lists $0.25/$2.50. Token cost is only part of the bill - add the per-request search fee (separate row). One source reports that Sonar moved into Perplexity's Agent API on 2026-09-27 and the old model names are gone; unconfirmed, and a strong reason to re-verify this provider before quoting.

offerings.name: Sonar Pro
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only. Plus the per-request search fee.

offerings.name: Sonar Reasoning Pro
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: Sonar Deep Research
offerings.notes: Reported to charge $5 per 1,000 searches rather than the tiered Sonar search fee. A single deep-research call can issue many searches, so cost per call is far less predictable than the token rate suggests.

offerings.name: Sonar search fee (by context size)
offerings.notes: Tiered by search context size: reported at $5 per 1,000 (low), $8 (medium), $12 (high). The $8 medium rate is stored here as the representative figure. Charged on top of token costs.

offerings.name: Search API (standalone, no generated answer)
offerings.notes: Raw search results with no LLM answer and no token charges. Worth knowing about: for checking what a search surface returns, this is far cheaper than paying tokens for a generated answer you then have to parse.

offerings.name: SERP API - Standard queue
offerings.notes: Cheapest credible SERP source in the catalog at $0.0006 per 10-result SERP. The catch is that the Standard queue is asynchronous - results take minutes, not seconds. Fine for scheduled or batch rank checks, not for anything interactive.

offerings.name: SERP API - Live mode
offerings.notes: $0.002 per 10-result SERP - roughly 3.3x the Standard queue for synchronous results.

offerings.name: Google Search API
offerings.notes: Volume-tiered: reported $50 for 50,000 credits ($1.00 per 1,000) down to $0.30 per 1,000 at the $3,750 tier. Credits reportedly expire after 6 months, so buying ahead for a small client load wastes money.

offerings.name: Google Search API
offerings.notes: Most expensive per query at entry level: Starter is $25/month for 1,000 searches. Scales to Big Data at $275 for 30,000 ($9.17 per 1,000). Unused searches do not roll over, so effective cost depends on how fully you use the plan - a part-used plan is worse than the headline rate.

offerings.name: ChatGPT Go
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: ChatGPT Plus
offerings.notes: Consistent across sources.

offerings.name: ChatGPT Pro
offerings.notes: Sources list Pro tiers at both $100 and $200 per month; it is unclear whether these are two tiers or disagreement about one.

offerings.name: Claude Pro
offerings.notes: About $17/month equivalent if billed annually at $200/year. Not read from the pricing page directly.

offerings.name: Claude Max (5x usage)
offerings.notes: 5x Pro usage.

offerings.name: Claude Max (20x usage)
offerings.notes: 20x Pro usage.

offerings.name: Google AI Pro (formerly Gemini Advanced)
offerings.notes: Sources are inconsistent about whether the Gemini Advanced name still exists.

offerings.name: Google AI Ultra
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.

offerings.name: Perplexity Pro
offerings.notes: Or $200/year. Relevant to AEO work: Pro changes which search surfaces and models a user sees, so a client's own experience of 'what Perplexity says about us' depends on their tier.

offerings.name: Perplexity Max
offerings.notes: Or $2,000/year.

offerings.name: Perplexity Enterprise
offerings.notes: Third-party reporting only.
